skills.name: maxclicks
skills.description: Work with the maxclicks email, CRM, and automation platform: manage contacts, objects, and records; define schemas and attributes (including AI-generated evaluated attributes); fire events; send emails, author and send templates; build segments and broadcasts with natural-language filters; build and trigger workflows; manage webhooks, domains, senders, topics, imports, API keys, and suppressions; or build a maxclicks integration in any language. Use whenever a task mentions maxclicks, or involves its API, CLI (`maxclicks`), SDKs (Node, Python, Go, PHP/Laravel, Ruby, Java, Rust), or MCP server.

skills.name: maxclicks-adaptyle
skills.description: Write or edit the CONTENT of a maxclicks email template: the subject and body in Adaptyle, maxclicks's LLM-enhanced templating language layered over Liquid. Use whenever a task asks to write, draft, generate, or edit an email template's subject/body, an MJML or HTML raw template, an Adaptyle prompt tag, manifest, or hidden block, or to personalize email copy with AI at send time.

skills.name: maxclicks-broadcasts
skills.description: Create, schedule, or send a maxclicks broadcast, a one-time mass email to a contact-schema audience (everyone, a segment, or an AI-generated custom filter). Use for newsletters, promos, or any "email this whole audience" task.

skills.name: maxclicks-contacts
skills.description: Create, import, update, search, or delete contacts, customers, users, or business objects (records) in maxclicks. Use for CRM/contact-list operations against the maxclicks API, CLI, or SDKs.

skills.name: maxclicks-deliverability
skills.description: Add and verify a sending domain, or create a saved sender profile, in maxclicks. Use before sending any email from a new domain, when DNS/SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup is needed, or when a template/broadcast needs a "from" address.

skills.name: maxclicks-email
skills.description: Send an email or a stored template to a contact through maxclicks. Use when a task involves sending transactional or marketing email, template sends, or email suppression via the maxclicks API, CLI, or SDKs.

skills.name: maxclicks-events
skills.description: Track or fire events (purchase completed, signup, cart abandoned, etc.) into maxclicks to trigger workflows and webhooks. Use when instrumenting an app or backfilling events via the maxclicks API, CLI, or SDKs.

skills.name: maxclicks-imports
skills.description: Bulk-import contacts or objects into maxclicks from a CSV file, poll import status, and download the per-row failure log. Use for real bulk loads (hundreds+ rows), not one-off record writes.

skills.name: maxclicks-segments
skills.description: Create, list, count, or update maxclicks segments, AI-generated contact filters defined by a natural-language prompt. Use for audience definitions, saved filters, or "contacts where..." style queries against the maxclicks API or CLI.

skills.name: maxclicks-templates
skills.description: Create, list, get, update, duplicate, or delete a reusable maxclicks email template (the authoring CRUD, separate from sending). Use when a task needs to define a template's data shape, recipient, sender, or metadata, not just send an existing one.

skills.name: maxclicks-topics
skills.description: Create, list, update, or delete a maxclicks communication topic (e.g. "Marketing", "Product Updates"), the consent-scoped grouping for marketing sends. Use when wiring a template's or broadcast's communicationTopicId, or building a preference center.

skills.name: maxclicks-webhooks
skills.description: Create, list, update, delete, or rotate maxclicks outgoing webhooks, and verify inbound webhook signatures. Use when wiring maxclicks events to an external endpoint or handling maxclicks webhook deliveries.

skills.name: maxclicks-workflows
skills.description: Start or trigger a maxclicks workflow / automation via its incoming-webhook step. Use when a task needs to kick off a maxclicks workflow with a payload from an external system.
